messages:
Anya Li: Quick sync — I'm drafting the Eyesurface prio (single pane observability for inference). Need to decide M1 scope and launch gates by EOD. TL;DR proposal: 1) Dashboard: per-model/per-route cost + 95th latency, 2) Trace hooks: lightweight correlation headers + sampling config, 3) Error analysis: bubble-up root-cause tags (model, quantization profile, region), 4) Cost ledger: per-customer monthly burn preview. Thoughts?
Matt Russo: +1 on cost ledger, high ROI for sales + platform. Question: do we ship traces as full spans or links to traces hosted in tracing system?
Kevin Patel: For M1 keep traces as links (trace-id in logs + link-to-trace). Full-span ingest at scale is hard and increases cost quickly. We should provide an enrichment view that resolves links to a sample span on demand.
Sara Cho: Launch criteria idea:
- Instrumentation coverage >= 70% of Prod QPS (hot routes)
- Trace-link resolution working for 90% of linked requests in last 24h
- Dashboards show token-cost by route over last 7 days
- No P0s from customers in the pilot cohort for 2 consecutive weeks
If those are green we flip feature flag to broader orgs.
Anya Li: +Agree with conservative trace approach. Kevin, can you scope sampling + header injection work? estimate in story points?
Kevin Patel: Header injection + sampling hook = 3 pts. Trace-link resolver + sample span fetch = 5 pts. Instrumentation checklist + tests = 2 pts. Total ~10 pts.
Matt Russo: Customer ask: FinWest needs per-customer token cost breakdown visible to their SREs. Emily: can you confirm which customers to include in pilot?
Emily K.: Pilot: FinWest, Shoply, and a stealth startup (NDA). Will coordinate with customer success to get feature flags set.
Sara Cho: UX ask: dashboards should let PMs slice by model version and quantization profile. Also add a simple anomaly alert for sudden 3x cost increase on a route.
Anya Li: Good catch. On rollout policy: default to OFF for orgs, ON for pilot via flag, and safe-fallback to cached metrics if downstream cost service is slow. Must have A/B rollback.
DevOps Bot: deploy-bot: branch "eyesurface/m1" deployed to staging at commit 9f3a2b7 — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:
Kevin Patel: Example quick query for cost ledger (pseudo):
```
SELECT sum(tokens_cost) AS cost, model, route
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model, route
ORDER BY cost DESC
```
This will be the backend join for dashboards; we can optimize with daily aggregates.
Matt Russo: Prioritization note: If we must cut scope, drop sample span fetching and ship trace links + sampled metadata first. Add sample span fetch in M1.p1
Anya Li: Agree. Cut list if needed: full-span ingest, long-term retention for sample spans, per-token microbilling export (M2). Keep: dashboards, trace links, cost ledger, error grouping.
Sara Cho: QA checklist highlights: synthetic requests across models, trace-link end-to-end test (trace-id surfacing), cost drift regression test (compare expected vs observed cost for synthetic load).
Kevin Patel: Also include a cheap feature in M1: route-level caching of recent trace links to speed link-resolution. 1 pt.
Emily K.: I'll schedule pilot onboarding next Tue and collect initial success criteria from customers. We should define what 'no P0s' means for pilot (e.g., SLA breach or data missing).
Anya Li: I'll convert this thread to a short PRD and attach acceptance criteria. Action items: @Kevin scope + PR, @Sara QA checklist, @Emily pilot coordination, @Matt prioritize backlog with sales ask. If anyone objects to the scope cuts, speak now or in PRD. :thumbsup:
